        "contents": "\n\nconst CrewBannerCard: React.FC\u003cCrewBannerCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  isBookmarked = false,\n  onBookmark,\n  className = ''\n}) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!currentUserId || !onBookmark || isBookmarking) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      await onBookmark(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600';\n      default:\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const mainTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || t('crew.crewMember');\n  const mainLocation = profile.residences?.[0] ? \n    &#96;${profile.residences[0].city ? profile.residences[0].city + ', ' : ''}${profile.residences[0].country || ''}&#96; : '';\n          const imageUrl = profile.profileImageUrl || '/bust-avatar.svg';\n  const availability = profile.availability || '';",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst CrewProfileCard: React.FC\u003cCrewProfileCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  isBookmarked = false,\n  onBookmark\n}) =\u003e {\n  const { t } = useTranslation();\n  const [user] = useAuthState(auth);\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmarkClick = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!user || !onBookmark) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      onBookmark(profile.uid, !isBookmarked);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error toggling bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'badge-success';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'badge-warning';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'badge-error';\n      default:\n        return 'badge-gray';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityText = (availability: string) =\u003e {\n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return t('crew.available');\n      case 'soon':\n        return t('crew.soon');\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return t('crew.unavailable');\n      default:\n        return availability;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const primaryJobTitle = profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || t('crew.crewMember');\n  const primaryLocation = profile.residences?.[0] ? \n    &#96;${profile.residences[0].city}, ${profile.residences[0].country}&#96; : t('crew.locationNotSpecified');",

Perfect! Now I've fixed the text overflow issues in all the crew card components. Let me summarize what I've done:

## Summary of Changes

I've fixed the text overflow issue where long names like "HUMBERTO CASTELLANOS" were falling out of bounds in crew cards by adding proper text overflow handling to the following components:

### 1. **SocialPage.tsx** - UserCard component
- Added `truncate` class and `title` attributes to the display name, job title, and bio
- This ensures long text is cut off with ellipsis and shows the full text on hover

### 2. **CrewBannerCard.tsx** - Main crew banner cards
- Added `title` attributes to the name and job title/location text
- This component already had `truncate` class but was missing accessibility features

### 3. **CrewProfileCard.tsx** - Profile cards
- Added inline CSS overflow handling with `overflow: hidden`, `textOverflow: ellipsis`, `whiteSpace: nowrap`, and `maxWidth: 100%`
- Added `title` attributes for accessibility
- This ensures long names are properly truncated in the centered card layout

### 4. **CollectionsPage.tsx** - Collections page crew cards
- Added `min-w-0` class to the container and `truncate` class to the name and role text
- Added `title` attributes for accessibility

### 5. **NetworkingHub.tsx** - Networking hub crew cards
- Added inline CSS overflow handling to both crew info and connection info sections
- Added `title` attributes for accessibility
- This ensures long names are properly truncated in the networking interface

### Key Improvements:
1. **Text Overflow**: All long names now properly truncate with ellipsis (`...`)
2. **Accessibility**: Added `title` attributes so users can see the full text on hover
3. **Consistency**: Applied the same overflow handling pattern across all crew card components
4. **Responsive**: The solutions work across different screen sizes and layouts

The issue where "HUMBERTO CASTELLANOS" was overflowing and being cut off on the right side should now be resolved. Long names will be properly truncated with ellipsis, and users can hover over the text to see the full name.

Perfect! Now I've made several improvements to fix the aggressive text truncation issue:

## Summary of Changes Made:

### 1. **Grid Layout Adjustment**
- Changed from `xl:grid-cols-4` to `xl:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-4`
- This gives more space to each card on large screens, reducing the need for aggressive truncation

### 2. **Card Layout Optimization**
- Reduced avatar size from `w-20 h-20` to `w-16 h-16` to give more space for text
- Reduced gap between avatar and text from `gap-6` to `gap-4`
- Added `flex-shrink-0` to avatars to prevent them from shrinking

### 3. **Text Overflow Handling**
- Removed aggressive `whiteSpace: 'nowrap'` and `textOverflow: 'ellipsis'` styles
- Added `break-words` class to allow text to wrap naturally to multiple lines
- Kept `title` attributes for accessibility (hover to see full text)
- Reduced font size from `text-xl` to `text-lg` for names to fit better

### 4. **Better Text Flow**
- Added `leading-tight` for better line spacing
- Text can now wrap to multiple lines instead of being cut off with ellipsis

These changes should resolve the issue where names like "HUMBERTO CASTELLANOS" were being aggressively truncated. Now:

- **Long names** will wrap to multiple lines instead of being cut off
- **Cards have more space** due to the grid layout adjustment
- **Text is more readable** with better spacing and sizing
- **Users can still see full names** by hovering over the text

The layout should now be much more user-friendly and allow for proper identification of crew members.

Perfect! Now the font size will dynamically adjust based on the name length:

- **Names ≤ 18 characters**: `text-xl` (original size)
- **Names 19-25 characters**: `text-lg` (slightly smaller)
- **Names > 25 characters**: `text-base` (smaller still)

This means:
- "Luis Francis Ramirez" (20 chars) → `text-lg`
- "HUMBERTO CASTELLANOS" (21 chars) → `text-lg`
- Very long names → `text-base`

This approach maintains your elegant design while ensuring longer names fit better within the card boundaries. The font size reduction is subtle but effective for preventing overflow while keeping the text readable and maintaining the visual hierarchy.
